findings.detail: The handoff and start prompt declare _specs/agent-delivery-session-launches/ADV-CAS-S1 Visible Adapter Smoke.md as Target Spec, but no file exists at that path.
The kickoff prompt leaves Control Index / Queue blank, so the Target ID, Target Role, handoff pointer, verdict, workspace and allowed write-set cannot be reconciled against a current control row.

The matching run directory contains start-prompt.md and app-server-transcript.jsonl only; launch-request.json and evidence.json are absent, so spec-change-delivery rule 28a cannot confirm a current queued/launched transition for the same Target ID and handoff path.

The kickoff declares Target Role workflow-step, while the hardened ADV-CAS-S1 adapter spec defines S1 as a child implementation target. The smoke handoff itself has no Target Role field to resolve this discrepancy.
